purpose: Curated public evidence available to the recruiter-review API. This catalogue is an evidence boundary, not a candidate scoring system.

records.label: CV: product operations and workflow design
records.excerpt: Product and operations practitioner who turns messy operating problems into clear, buildable work.

records.label: CV: customer journey and business model work
records.excerpt: A consulting assignment analysed the end-to-end customer journey and produced prioritised product, flow, business-model, and scaling recommendations.

records.label: CV: risk analysis and contract review
records.excerpt: Public CV facts document finance, risk-analysis, contract-review, and process-improvement experience.

records.label: Job-agent: decision-led product work
records.excerpt: A public prototype documents scoped product reasoning and implementation decisions; it is work in progress and not market-validated.

records.label: Job-agent: product framing and workflow strategy
records.excerpt: Job-agent is framed as a reviewed career workflow product spanning job discovery, fit and context analysis, CV/application support, feedback, privacy, and consent.

records.label: Personal AI Harness: human-gated workflow design
records.excerpt: The public recursive workflow proof documents a human-gated system loop that executes, reviews, detects patterns, and promotes confirmed patterns into reusable infrastructure through scheduled research and bounded automation.

records.label: Job-agent: AI-native workflow execution
records.excerpt: The Job-agent case study explicitly documents AI-native workflow design: AI assistance is integrated into a reviewed workflow rather than treated as an unchecked generator.

records.label: Recursive workflow: human-gated improvement
records.excerpt: A supporting proof source documents a human-gated workflow for evaluating and promoting reusable improvements.

records.label: Decision log: trade-offs and traceability
records.excerpt: The public decision log links context, options, trade-offs, decisions, and next actions.

records.label: Decision log: bounded automation and validation
records.excerpt: A public decision entry documents choosing a bounded canary before expanding scheduled finding intake, showing staged validation before automation is scaled.

records.label: Decision log: reusable infrastructure and governance
records.excerpt: Public decision entries document shared skill boundaries, runtime-specific adaptations, and explicit failure controls for reusable infrastructure.

records.label: Decision log: research synthesis and decision support
records.excerpt: A public decision entry documents placing the decision, recommended action, response options, and concise evidence near the top of decision-heavy reports.

records.label: Decision log: stakeholder understanding and decision support
records.excerpt: A public decision entry documents structuring decision-heavy reports around the decision, recommended action, response options, and concise evidence to make them easier to understand and act on.

records.label: Decision log: commercial strategy and prioritisation
records.excerpt: A public Job-agent decision entry records a time-boxed job-search sprint and lightweight monthly plan as pricing hypotheses while willingness to pay remains unvalidated.

records.label: Job-agent: synthetic-demo boundary
records.excerpt: The Job-agent company fixture is synthetic-only. It demonstrates product behaviour and cannot establish production outcomes.

records.label: Information diet: supporting profile context
records.excerpt: A public supporting signal documents aggregate learning-input patterns. It does not establish expertise or employment experience.
